serviceDescription:
Audits a public website's product positioning, messaging and conversion copy, returning a Reveal Index score (0-100), a Blindspot Map of findings, a prioritised Blueprint and an Action Queue. Analysis is text-only over server-rendered HTML; every finding quotes page text verified against the pages actually fetched.
You provide: url (required), an absolute public http(s) URL to audit. Optional: timeoutSeconds (number, default 180, max 300) and format ("markdown" or "json") when exporting. Call revel_analyze_website for an analysisId, then poll revel_get_analysis until status is completed or partial.
